30-30-120: both 30-degree apexes not good (wedge test); the 120-degree apex good in exactly 3 directions 210/240/270, two of them collinear with an edge; witness side^2 = 1/3
equilateral: 3 vertices good, each with exactly one good direction, side^2 = 1
float_prescreen: no float-good / exact-not-good vertex over the named shapes

rotated_pair_M0.note: an edge and its own 60-degree rotate about O both on the curve: a one-parameter family of inscribed triangles, i.e. an ARC of good directions rather than isolated ones

square: 4 corners good, one good direction each, side^2 = 8 - 4*sqrt3
